page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel Xeon 8475B processor with an x86_64 architecture and a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density make this instance suitable for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable compute performance without the overhead of GPU hardware. Appropriate workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that fit within the 128.0 GB memory envelope.
